title: Myeolchi Noodle Stir Fry
description: A Japanese-inspired stir fry with myeolchi, noodles, and a hint of anchovy umami. This dish is a fusion of sweet and savory flavors, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Rinse the myeolchi and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and rinse the myeolchi, then chop it into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped myeolchi and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the soy sauce, sugar (if using), and chopped green onions to the skillet.
Stir in the cooked noodles and cooked myeolchi.
Add the anchovy fillets to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving dish and garnish with sesame seeds (if using).
